{{Vanilla|Trial Chambers}}
'''Trial Chambers''' generate as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes their chest, vault, pot and trial spawner loot, and adds rules that also apply to the [[Abbey]].

== Changes ==
* A [[warding stone]] cannot be placed inside Trial Chambers or an Abbey; it explodes when placed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/warding_stone/forbidden.mcfunction}}</ref>
* After the [[Ender Dragon]] is killed, hostile mobs still spawn inside Trial Chambers and Abbeys, although they stop spawning on the rest of the surface (see [[Surface]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/predicate/in_dungeon.json}}</ref>
* Trial spawners drop keys from <code>spawners/trial_chamber/key</code>, with an 80% chance of a {{MCW|Trial Key}} and a 20% chance of an {{MCW|Ominous Trial Key}}. Their consumable drops are the pack's foods.
* Vaults contain [[divine fragment]]s, [[sacred texts]], [[crystal heart]]s and pack equipment. Ominous vaults can give [[silver bullion]] and the "Elegy of the Abbey" [[music disc]].
* The [[Archaeologist]] sells Trial Chamber Maps. See [[Explorer maps]].
